tasks.description: Add hostname, os_user columns and their indexes to bug_reports.
Add enabled column to user table.
Create update_releases table for API-managed software updates.
Add critical_version column to update_releases.
Create updater_clients and updater_events tables for EMLy Updater fleet stats.
Replace the exclusive channel ENUM with independent is_stable/is_beta flags on update_releases, so a release can be both stable and beta at once.
Create updater_releases table for the EMLy Updater self-update manifest.
Add product column to updater_events so EMLy client traffic and updater self-update traffic can be told apart.

Add hwid column to updater_clients so clients sending X-EMLy-HWID are identified by that instead of hostname/ad_domain, with the old hostname-based identification kept as a fallback for clients that don't send it yet.
Create remote_config_revisions table backing GET /v2/config and its admin routes.
Add config_revision/config_fetched_at columns to updater_clients so the fleet's remote-config rollout can be tracked without new telemetry rows.
Add a covering (product, event_type, created_at) index to updater_events so the /v2/stats/summary rollup stops full-scanning an index and looking up every candidate row.

Drop updater_events.idx_product_created, now redundant against the covering index from task 12, to cut write amplification on the insert-heavy event path. Runs after task 12 in file order, so the replacement index always exists first.
Add logged_user/serial/product columns to updater_clients so the X-EMLy-LoggedUser, X-EMLy-Serial and X-EMLy-Product headers the updater now sends are recorded against the client row.
Create the bans table backing the permanent IP/HWID/hostname blocks and their admin routes.
Add emly_version column to updater_clients to track the version of the EMLy client.

Add logged_user_state/logged_user_disconnected_at columns to updater_clients so the X-EMLy-LoggedUserState and X-EMLy-LoggedUserDisconnectedAt headers tell a user at the machine from an RDP session left disconnected.
Add the os_version column to updater_clients so the X-EMLy-OSVersion header the updater now sends records which Windows build each machine runs.

Add a (client_id, created_at) index to updater_events so GET /v2/stats/clients/{id} reads its 50 most recent events as a bounded backwards scan instead of reading and sorting that client's whole history.

Drop updater_events.idx_client_id, now redundant against the composite index from task 18 (which also satisfies the foreign key), to cut write amplification on the insert-heavy event path. Runs after task 18 in file order, so the replacement index always exists first.

Create the updater_event_hourly rollup table, backfilled from existing updater_events rows, so /v2/stats/summary and /v2/stats/events read pre-aggregated counts instead of scanning raw events on every call and every WS push.
Create the products registry (seeded with emly) so the updates surface can distribute more than one product.
Add product to update_releases (existing rows become emly), make version unique per product and index the per-product stable/beta lookups.
Create updater_client_products (installed version per client and product), seeded from updater_clients.emly_version.
Create user_products (which products each dashboard user may see), assigning emly to every existing user.
Repair a database that ran the v3 branch's product ENUM('app','updater') and so skipped migration 23: make product VARCHAR(20) and turn 'app' into emly.
Drop the v3 branch's idx_product_channel, left on product alone after channel was dropped.
Drop idx_is_stable on a database that skipped migration 23 (replaced by idx_product_stable).
Drop idx_is_beta on a database that skipped migration 23 (replaced by idx_product_beta).
Add idx_product_stable on a database that skipped migration 23.
Add idx_product_beta on a database that skipped migration 23.
